reviews.text:
Good service if you can get it. We've taken our dog here a few times and they do good work and we've always left happy. However,  its nearly impossible to actually book services with them. The online booking tool never works and more recently when I've tried to call I was put on hold for about 40 minutes. Once I remembered I was on hold, I hung up and tried to call back only to  get an automated voice message from Verizon saying they were busy and couldn't leave a message. Tried to call back about 10 times throughout the course of the day and always got the same automated responses.

The people are nice, the prices are fair, and my dog has always left happy, but it shouldn't be this hard to get responses from a company that I'm trying to give my money to.

I always have a great experience with Temple! They are so kind, plenty of availability, and my anxious pup is treated so sweetly. I just love when I pick her up and she is transformed from an Ewok to my precious Shih Tzu again :)
Thank you so much for the five stars! We truly appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and Birdie again.

I have been taking my dog here for years and LOVE temple!  Tara always does such an amazing job.  The first few visits my dog was super scared.  Now while it's still not his favorite place to be, he is much more comfortable and I know it's because the staff is so sweet to him.  Thank you <3
April ALWAYS does such an amazing job. Our puppy is excited to see her and leaves knowing exactly how fabulous she looks!!!

Our dogs have been going to Temple of the Dog for about a decade now and I wouldn't trust anywhere else. They are always careful and deliberate in taking care of our baby boy Milo and make sure he gets the best cut possible! They are great at communication and keeping me in the loop about upcoming appointments and when to pick him up, and they give him extra love while he is there.

Tara and all the staff are just super people who do a remarkable job with all sorts of dog personalities to juggle. I can't say enough about this place. We will be taking our puppers here for decades to come.

To best place in the city to get your dog groomed, I’ve been a loyal customer for many years going back to the Milwaukee Avenue location. We have a King Charles Cavalier that requires a very specific cut and Temple has never failed us. Great service great people with great attitudes. I highly recommend!

We have been going to Tara since 2018. First it was George and now Willy. We greatly appreciate the fact that she treated George and now Willy as if they’re her own. Excellent groomer and priced reasonably. I would highly recommend Tara and her staff. Thank you for keeping them clean and looking good.
Temple of the Dogs is great!  April does such an amazing job on my collie and my mom’s golden doodle.  I am so happy that I found this place! They are so very nice!
Our dog Rudy has been coming here for years and each time she loves her visit! She looks great and has a wonderful time.
We’ve been going here for 2+ years. They always do a fabulous job. Everyone is so professional and polite. They take great care of our pups.
This place is great! Our dog is very anxious and doesn't like his paws touched at all, but the groomers were so gentle and are the only ones able to trim his nails! Highly recommend

Cut on my doodle left her heavy around the eyes so I had to thin it out myself at home. Ran out of bows at 2:00 on Saturday? Not sure how you let that happen when your sole purpose is to groom dogs. Staff eating food all around the grooming floor by the dogs, which was kind of gross. No sample board to communicate desired length (they are like $30) and price highest of any place I've been. Will not be going back.
Thank you for the 5 stars—it truly means a lot to our team. We’re so grateful for your support!

My 4 year old dog Lucky doesn’t love the groomer but Temple of the Dog took such great care of him, he was just lounging around and chilling when I came to pick him up. Not to mention his haircut is the cutest he’s ever had! Will always be coming back here, so glad I tried someplace new.
